goal: Allow developers and node operators to test BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules in Bitcoin Core
Prepare fixes for legacy flaws like quadratic sigop exhaustion, Merkle collisions, and timewarp attacks
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile with no blockers or rebases pending
agreement: Broad concept approval to make BIP 54 rules available for testing ahead of mainnet activation
Concept support for having the functionality ready without mainnet activation (0xB10C)
Concept approval without stated reasons (dergoegge, fanquake, hsjoberg, nervana21, stickies-v, theStack)
Question on edge-case coverage and cache behavior during mempool reorgs remains unanswered (ariard)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prepares fixes for severe consensus flaws like quadratic sigops and Merkle collisions
It gives developers high leverage to test and vet consensus cleanup logic prior to any network activation
Immediate impact is limited because rules are active only on regtest and remain inactive on mainnet
